metadata.pse.domain.doc: The definition selecting this engineering goal.
The selected case declaring this goal.
The selected instance declaring this goal.
The document path, relative to the package root.
Exact original UTF-8 source of a text document, including whitespace and comments (ADR-0068); absent for a data document.
Exact original bytes of a package data document (ADR-0125); absent for a text document.
The definition selecting this engineering scale.
The selected case declaring this engineering scale.
The selected instance declaring this engineering scale.
The fit declaring this engineering scale.
What kind of entity it is.
An attribute, never identity: a rename changes this and nothing else.
An attribute, never identity — except under the `named` policy, where it determines the identity at creation and a rename is a new entity.
Containment: flowsheet ⊃ unit ⊃ control volume ⊃ state block.

The specialized definition the requirement belongs to: the root declaration of the model it is declared for. A modeling preparation's requirements name its root, an implicit block's trial hints their enclosing model's; a fit's parameter requirements name the one definition all its experiments specialize, and none when they specialize different ones.
The case declaration the requirement belongs to: the solved root when it is a case or a test, otherwise absent.

The instance whose preparation declared the requirement: the solved root instance (a fit experiment's own instance), or the implicit block whose trial hints declared it. Absent for a fit's parameter requirements and a generated rate system's.
The fit whose parameter requirement this is; absent otherwise.
What kind of package it is.
`explicit` or `named` (blueprint §5.1). Recorded on the package, never in the ID.
The declared dependencies, each a package identity and a typed version requirement (ADR-0123 Outcome 7). Phase 0 admits exact version requirements only. Version two types the requirement.
The digest of the package's documents.
The digest the package is pinned by.
The distance from the root package.
The `provenance.derivations` row this fact came from.
The entity that kept the name.
The package version that deprecated it.
The column's position, which is its ordinal.
One quantity contract for the whole column.
The referenced relation, when the column is a reference.
The referenced column, when the column is a reference.
Complete canonical Arrow field declaration, including every nested domain facet and metadata entry.
The entity identity the column carries, declared or inherited through its reference.
The IDAES spelling, for the §6.14 parity enumerations.
Declared but no longer selectable; kept so old artifacts still decode.
The identity name, a snake-case entity noun.
The relation whose single-column primary key was declared the identity's owner, if any.
The owning key column, if any.
What kind of statement it makes.
Whether a violation stops a commit.
The registry name, for example `semantic_id` or `enum:PhaseType`.
The canonical Arrow storage rendering. Never a `Debug` rendering (blueprint §5.3).
The `ARROW:extension:name`, when the type is an extension use.
The JSON Schema of `ARROW:extension:metadata`, when the type is an extension use.
The migration steps, one per line, in application order.
The namespace, which is also the catalog schema name.
The relation name inside its namespace.
The primary key column names, in key order.
How much a consumer may rely on the shape.
Native DataFusion SQL predicates; every predicate must evaluate to true.
Unique keys besides the primary key, in declaration order.
Table-level (composite) references to a target key, in declaration order.
The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.
The definition whose selected goal was assessed.
The selected case whose goal was assessed.
The selected instance whose goal was assessed.
The fit whose goal was assessed.
The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.
The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.

Whether the quantity is certified or why it is withheld (`reason`, with the typed cause in `detail`), whether it is conditional on a discrete assignment, and the verdicts of the KKT point it was read from when the analysis ran: independent active gradients, strict complementarity, second-order sufficiency, the count of weakly active constraints, the 1-norm condition estimate of the normalized KKT matrix and the backward error of a refined backsolve.

Exact, the inverse reduced Hessian of the fit's KKT analysis, when the fit used the exact Hessian; Gauss–Newton otherwise, which neglects residual curvature and is valid under the declared model with small residuals.
The free fitted parameters in fit order: the order of every list in the row.
Recorded positive free-parameter coordinate scales in the covariance's units.
Σ row-major, in row-parameter unit × column-parameter unit.
The end in the parameter's unit; absent when the chain stopped.
Pinned fits the end's profile chain solved; zero for a Wald end.
Why a chain stopped: the typed cause of its last failure.
The variable or row differentiated; nil for the objective.
The unit of the variable, of the row's quantity, or of the objective's quantity.
For a variable, dx/dp in its unit per parameter unit; for the objective, df*/dp in the authored sense; absent for a row.

For a row, the derivative of its multiplier; for a variable, of its bound multiplier z_L - z_U; both in the minimization convention of `solve_constraints.dual`, zero where the constraint is inactive; absent for the objective.
The point's position in its chain, in solve order.
The pinned parameter value, in the parameter's unit.
The point whose solution seeded this pinned fit; absent when the fit estimate seeded it (PS-11).
An actual terminal callback latch, absent in historical records that did not observe it.
The pinned fit's objective f, half the weighted residual sum of squares.
√(2·max(f - f*, 0)) against the estimate's objective f*.
The pinned fit was qualified stationary or better and feasible, and the chain used it.
The typed cause of a failed pinned fit.
The fit run whose parameter covariance was propagated: this run for a fit's own predictions.
Infinity norm after dividing each covariance axis by its declared parameter scale.
64*EPSILON*n*max(1,norm_inf), used for dimensionless symmetry and the least eigenvalue.
Least finite eigenvalue returned by lower-triangle sequential faer without eigenvectors; no matrix repair was made.
The fitted parameters propagated, in the covariance's order.
The solved variables of a modeling step, or the included observations whose predictions a fit propagates: the order of every other output list.
Σ_y row-major, in row-output unit × column-output unit.
The parameters, in request order: the order of every list in the row.
Each parameter's resolved coordinate scale S_p.
The objective's resolved coordinate scale S_f.
d²f*/dp² row-major, in the authored objective sense: objective units per row-parameter unit per column-parameter unit.
The eigenvalues of the normalized matrix, ascending.
Its unit eigenvectors, column-major: column k belongs to eigenvalue k.
The right singular vector's position, by decreasing singular value.
Its singular value; zero beyond the number of included observations.
The singular value exceeds the fit's relative rank cutoff.
The direction's component along the parameter, in coordinates divided by the parameter's declared scale.
The specialized definition the step solved: the root declaration its model specializes. A fit names the one definition all its experiments specialize, and none when they specialize different ones.
The case declaration the step solved: its root when that root is a case or a test (a case with an oracle), otherwise absent. A fit names the one case all its experiments solve, if they share one.

The instance the step's root became: the root declaration's own identity for an ordinary solve or simulation, the experiment's instance for a fit experiment. Absent for a fit, which spans its experiments' instances.
The fit the step solved; absent for a modeling solve or simulation.
Original specialized model interpreted by the producer; absent for a fit spanning different definitions.
Original fit when this context interprets a statistical product.
The run that produced the row: minted once when a run starts or a job is enqueued, and shared by the job's retried attempts. It names the execution, not the request's content.
The specialized definition the step solved: the root declaration its model specializes.
The case declaration the step solved: its root when that root is a case or a test, otherwise absent.
The instance the step's root became: the root declaration's own identity, or a fit experiment's instance.
Identity of the actual bound automatic or declared execution decision.
Independent original-model assessment; native termination remains separate.
Actual surrogate evaluation fidelity; absent for nonstatistical operations.
Complete retained library model-management options and correspondence key.
Observed statistical infill statistic; never a deterministic numerical accuracy certificate.
Library proposal in complete physical original-coordinate order; requires independent original screening/correction.
Actual approximation outputs; do not grant original feasibility or result permission.
Actual localized numerical path observations and attempted work; rank/nondegeneracy interpretations are estimated, never formal certificates. Missing curvature remains absent.
Actual started executions attributed once to the charging owner.
Actual evaluations including rejected trials; absent when not observable.
Presentation only; transitions and permissions derive from typed observations.
Lossless native literals by declared key name.
JSON Pointer with actual nested ordinals.
Exact observed Arrow field including metadata.

metadata.pse.contract.checks: {"atomic_or_defined":"(definition IS NULL AND dimension IS NOT NULL AND scale_to_canonical IS NOT NULL AND offset_to_canonical IS NOT NULL AND is_affine IS NOT NULL) OR (definition IS NOT NULL AND dimension IS NULL AND scale_to_canonical IS NULL AND offset_to_canonical IS NULL AND is_affine IS NULL AND reference_state_id IS NULL)","positive_scale":"scale_to_canonical IS NULL OR scale_to_canonical > 0"}

{"atomic_or_defined":"(definition IS NULL AND dimension IS NOT NULL AND scale_to_canonical IS NOT NULL AND offset_to_canonical IS NOT NULL AND is_affine IS NOT NULL) OR (definition IS NOT NULL AND dimension IS NULL AND scale_to_canonical IS NULL AND offset_to_canonical IS NULL AND is_affine IS NULL AND reference_state_id IS NULL)","positive_scale":"scale_to_canonical IS NULL OR scale_to_canonical > 0"}

{"one_evidence_value":"(kind = 'real' AND \"real\" IS NOT NULL AND \"integer\" IS NULL AND \"boolean\" IS NULL AND \"text\" IS NULL AND \"unavailable\" IS NULL) OR (kind = 'integer' AND \"real\" IS NULL AND \"integer\" IS NOT NULL AND \"boolean\" IS NULL AND \"text\" IS NULL AND \"unavailable\" IS NULL) OR (kind = 'boolean' AND \"real\" IS NULL AND \"integer\" IS NULL AND \"boolean\" IS NOT NULL AND \"text\" IS NULL AND \"unavailable\" IS NULL) OR (kind = 'text' AND \"real\" IS NULL AND \"integer\" IS NULL AND \"boolean\" IS NULL AND \"text\" IS NOT NULL AND \"unavailable\" IS NULL) OR (kind = 'unavailable' AND \"real\" IS NULL AND \"integer\" IS NULL AND \"boolean\" IS NULL AND \"text\" IS NULL AND \"unavailable\" IS NOT NULL)"}
{"base_or_derived":"(definition IS NULL) = (dimension IS NOT NULL) AND (definition IS NULL OR category IS NULL)"}
